subject: general
question: Which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the largest land area?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China**

 
 
• China, officially known as the People's Republic of China, is a country in East Asia.
 
• It is the world's most populated country, having a population of around 1.4 billion.
 
• It covers approximately 9.6 million square kilometres.
 
• It is the world's third-largest country by area.
 
• China shares its borders with 14 Sovereign Countries.
 
• They are Afghanistan, Bhutan, India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Mongolia, Myanmar, Nepal, North Korea, Russia, Tajikistan, and Vietnam.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is the** 7th largest** country in the world with an area of **3,287,263** square kilometres.
 
• India has** 2.41%** of the landmass against the geographical area of the World but supports as much as **18%** of the world's population.
 
• It measures** 3214 km** from North to South and **2933** from East to West. 
 
• Largest country area wise
 
 
• **Pakistan > Myanmar > Bangladesh**
 
 
 
• **Area of Pakistan: **796,100 km²
 
• **Area of Myanmar: **676,578 km²
 
• **Area of Bangladesh: **143,998 km²
